title: Compatibility constraints
# Compatibility constraints

- `COMPAT-001`: owner filtering remains exact and case-sensitive.
- `COMPAT-002`: no filters returns the same releases in their original order.
- `COMPAT-003`: filtering must not mutate the input array or release objects.
- `COMPAT-004`: a non-array releases argument continues to throw `TypeError`.

title: Release status filter specification
# Release status filter specification

- `SPEC-STATUS-001`: `filters.status` accepts one string or an array of strings.
- `SPEC-STATUS-002`: status comparison trims surrounding whitespace and ignores ASCII case.
- `SPEC-STATUS-003`: missing, blank, or non-string status filter values do not restrict results.
- `SPEC-STATUS-004`: an array matches a release when any normalized requested status matches.

This is the authoritative current specification. Re-importing this file after an edit must change the context returned by the CLI.

title: SDD-REL-001 release filter change
# Task SDD-REL-001

Change `filterReleases` so status filters accept one or more values and compare them case-insensitively after trimming. Preserve exact owner matching, stable input order, non-mutation, and the existing invalid-input error.

The target tests must fail against the retained before snapshot because the behavior is absent, then pass against the modified implementation. Regression tests must pass in both runs.
